# Setting up the Zoho Cliq MCP Server

# Setting up the Zoho Cliq MCP Server

You can integrate Zoho MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Cliq to trigger workflows and sync data across services with the help of popular AI agents.

You can follow the steps below to integrate Zoho MCP and Cliq:

1. Click on your profile image on the top-right corner.
2. Select **Bots & Tools**.

![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d096830db8f9507fdcc6e32f95c692401f1dccb60c440431fb925bd479d73fad681746c9372756729c835448828eb24d9c?inline=true)

1. Go to **Cliq MCP** in the **Integrations** window and select **Set Up MCP Server**.

![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d01e99db217ffaf04deaf12315d5c62774ab885c010243849ae7cc8b7888d787a8da88d5ecd5aeb924bc4a246582cd8bbc?inline=true)

1. Enter a server name and click on **Create server**.

![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d0511f5ac795fe170df7b69dcacd528db7a4dc2f201cb64182e8dcebb74021f96448ec89f1d9132c44fe84286b01cdd79c?inline=true)

![Notes](https://static.zohocdn.com/zoho-desk-editor/static/images/file.png/)**Note:** The server name should be alphanumeric with no spaces.

1. Once you create the server, you will have three options- **Tools**, **Connect** and **Connection**.

![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d02107c2c16834ccd158491565291bff26a9094dc8c62801c1c56deaa7d9163132d33e66d4b2221441318ad23e134642c5?inline=true)

You can now add various tools and connect the available AI agents to your MCP Server. You can check out this [Guide to Zoho Cliq's MCP Server](https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/zoho-cliq-mcp.html) to know how to connect and configure various tools with the AI agents.
